findings.title: Hard-coded database password
findings.explanation: Hard-coded credentials can be easily extracted from the source code, leading to unauthorized access to the database.
findings.suggestion: Store sensitive information like passwords in environment variables or secure vaults instead of hard-coding them.

findings.code: ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + username + "'");
findings.title: SQL Injection vulnerability
findings.explanation: Concatenating user input directly into SQL queries allows for SQL injection attacks, which can compromise the database.
findings.suggestion: Use PreparedStatement to safely parameterize the query: "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?" and set the parameter with ps.setString(1, username).

findings.title: Possible NullPointerException
findings.explanation: The 'conn' variable may be null if not initialized, leading to a NullPointerException when creating a Statement.
findings.suggestion: Ensure 'conn' is initialized before use or add null checks.

findings.code: PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?");
findings.title: N+1 Query Problem
findings.explanation: Executing a query for each user ID in a loop results in N+1 queries, which can severely impact performance with large lists.
findings.suggestion: Batch the queries or use a single query with IN clause to retrieve all users at once.

findings.title: Possible division by zero
findings.explanation: If 'users' is empty, this will lead to ArithmeticException due to division by zero.
findings.suggestion: Check if users.size() is zero before performing the division.

findings.title: Unexpected null return value
findings.explanation: Returning null may lead to NullPointerException in callers expecting a non-null User object.
findings.suggestion: Consider returning an Optional<User> instead of null.

findings.title: Resource Leak
findings.explanation: PreparedStatement and ResultSet are not closed, which can lead to resource leaks.
findings.suggestion: Use try-with-resources to ensure proper closure of PreparedStatement and ResultSet.
